name: config-reimplementation-research
goal: Research and produce a design brief for re-implementing the opencode config featureset using research-backed, optimal designs unconstrained by current implementation patterns

subtasks.name: research-round-1-planning-and-session-design
subtasks.description: Research planning system design and session plan architecture — how planning modes work, what the ideal session plan structure looks like, and how a planning session produces an optimal execution plan

subtasks.name: research-round-2-agent-and-delegation-design
subtasks.description: Research agent design patterns and delegation strategy — how to write ideal subagents, how to route tasks across agents, and how to balance speed/cost/correctness per session

subtasks.name: research-round-3-supporting-infrastructure
subtasks.description: Research context management, protocol systems, skills systems, slash commands, and general UX patterns for AI coding assistants

subtasks.name: synthesis
subtasks.description: HW-direct: read all round findings, compile research-brief.md and design-doc.md covering all 8 feature areas
